priorityList: Ensure Arcane Intellect is active before combat.
Use offensive Trinkets and Potions during your Frozen Orb or Ray of Frost windows.
Cast Flurry if Brain Freeze is active to apply Winter's Chill.
Cast Ice Lance if you have 2 charges of Fingers of Frost to avoid capping.
Cast Glacial Spike whenever you reach 5 Icicles.
Cast Ice Lance if Fingers of Frost is active.
Cast Ice Lance if the target has 6 or more stacks of the Freezing debuff to trigger Splinterstorm.
Cast Ray of Frost if you have fewer than 3 Icicles or during your Potion window.
Cast Flurry whenever available to apply Winter's Chill for your next two spells.
Cast Frostbolt as your main filler to generate Icicles and Brain Freeze procs.
Use Ice Nova or Cone of Cold if talented as high-priority movement fillers.
Cast Ice Lance as a last resort filler while moving if no other procs are available.
